translation: <ins>Zhitong San</ins> (Pain-Stopping Powder, 止痛散) stops pain and reduces swelling, quickens the blood and frees the channels, and wards off wind and expels cold. Fangfeng (Saposhnikovia), Jingjie (Schizonepeta), Danggui (Angelica), Qi'ai (mugwort), Mudanpi (moutan bark), Heshi (Carpesium), Shengma (Cimicifuga, one qian each), Kushen (Sophora), Tieline Tougucao (iron-wire penetrating-bone herb), Chishaoyao (red peony, two qian each), Chuanjiao (Sichuan pepper, three qian), Gancao (licorice, eight fen). Grind all together, put in a white cloth bag, tie the mouth, boil until rolling, and fumigate and wash. <ins>Bujin Wan</ins> (Sinew-Tonifying Pill, 補筋丸) (seen in the injury of the yugu bone) <ins>Wanling Gao</ins> (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏) (seen in the injury of the vertex).
